bingo.rapidApiKey.markdownDescription: Your own RapidAPI key for the Bingo API. Prefer the **Bingo: Set RapidAPI Key** command, which stores the key in VS Code SecretStorage instead of plain settings. This setting is only used as a fallback when no secret is stored. Get a free key (5 answers/month) from the [Bingo listing on RapidAPI](https://rapidapi.com/demorgansucks/api/bingo-verified-code-answers-api/playground).

description: AI code answers that are tested before you get them. Bingo generates Python code, runs it against tests in a sandbox, auto-fixes it up to 3 times, and only delivers code that passes — always with the test report.
name: bingo-verified-code-answers
